summary: Plan women’s empowerment campaigns with gender analysis, stakeholder mapping and measurable advocacy tools. Explore the course and review the outline.
lede: Women’s empowerment advocacy helps gender programme officers, campaign leads and policy advocates turn evidence about barriers into a plan for influencing decisions. They practise gender analysis, stakeholder power mapping and a Theory of Change, then develop a specific policy ask, coordinate coalition roles, draft audience-focused messages and select indicators to track progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to make women’s empowerment concerns actionable through advocacy, programme decisions or policy engagement. It suits early-career and experienced practitioners who want a structured method for developing an advocacy case and tracking its progress.
prerequisites: No coding or specialist software is required. Familiarity with a gender-equality, programme, policy, communications or community engagement issue will help you apply the exercises to your work.
